text.en: 1. This Order is the Co-operative Societies (Exemption under Section 97) (No. 2) Order 2018 and comes into operation on 16 July 2018.
3. The Co‑operative Societies (Exemption under Section 97) (No. 2) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 688/2013) is revoked.
